text: Wata on wi'u, onon ɓee sirkooɓe, ko ɗemɗe mon sifotoo e fenugol hoore Alla : Ɗum ɗoo no dagii, ɗum ɗoo no hari, fii no fefindoron fenaande e hoore Alla, harmingol ko O harminaa, maa dagin- tingol ko O daginaa. Pellet, ɓen fefindotooɓe fenaande e hoore Alla, ɓe malirtaa ko ɗaɓɓetee, ɓe daɗetee ko huletee.
